thread:
Sam (Growth): Heads up — launching a focused paid push next Tue. combo: search + retarget + creative refresh. short sprint, goal CPL <= $60, 300 demo signups/week.
Maria (Paid): Nice. What’s the initial daily budget and geo split? I can draft the bid curves.
Sam (Growth): Start $2k/day US + CA, scale to $4k if CPA holds. EU holdback at 30% for now.
Maria (Paid): Cool. I’ll set ad groups by funnel: high-intent exact, mid-intent phrasal, and retarget. Audience windows: 7/30/90.
Owen (Creative): For the refresh — 3 headlines, 2 hero images, 1 short demo clip. Need final assets by Mon 10am. Pinged design.
June (Ops): Landing page routing — we should route paid leads into the webinar nurture if they come from retarget. Current inbound flow: marketing->sales-funnel, want: marketing->webinar-nurture->sales-funnel. Is that ok?
Sam (Growth): Yes. Webinar nurture for retarget and mid-intent; high-intent direct to sales. Make sure UTMs for channel=paid_search, campaign=launch_pulse, creative=varA/B.
AdOps Bot: deploy plan queued:
```
campaign: launch_pulse
daily_budget: 2000
geo: US,CA
schedule: weekdays 8-20 PST
audiences: exact,phrase,retarget_7,retarget_30,retarget_90
```
Maria (Paid): I’ll run a 48h micro-test on exact match, small budget, and share early CPAs. If CPL < 55 -> shift +20% budget.
Owen (Creative): I'll include two new CTAs focused on 'Start a demo' and 'Watch 3-min overview'. Which should be primary?
Sam (Growth): Primary CTA = Start a demo for high-intent, Watch 3-min for mid/retarget.
June (Ops): Routing note: set lead source mapping so webinar signups flag as "nurture_paid" in CRM. Also add leadscore tag "paid_launch_v1".
Maria (Paid): Scheduling: creative swap cadence = day 4 and day 10. Bidding cadence: manual -> tCPA after 72h if volume >= 50 conversions.
Sam (Growth): Perfect. Action items: Maria: set campaigns + micro-test. Owen: final assets Mon 10am. June: update routing & UTMs. I’ll monitor and call a check-in Wed AM.
Owen (Creative): Got it. Uploading assets to /design/paid-launch/ now.
June (Ops): I’ll update the runbook and Slack alert for CPL breach (> $80) to #marketing-alerts.
Maria (Paid): Thanks — will post initial dashboard link when test spins up. :thumbsup:
Sam (Growth): Thanks team. Quick note — for retarget audience stitching use sequential creatives: clip -> hero -> demo CTA. small experiment but likely better flow.
Maria (Paid): Noted. Will set creative rotation and report.
Sam (Growth): Closing thread — see y'all in the check-in.
